If you mean **Newport, VIC (Melbourne)**, there are several locksmiths that install smart locks and service the area.

Here are a few options:

- SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – Specialist installer for a wide range of smart lock brands (Yale, Lockwood, Philips, Aqara, Eufy, Schlage, Samsung and more). They service Melbourne, including the western suburbs. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/service?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Five Star Locksmiths | Locksmiths Melbourne – General locksmith offering smart lock installation across Melbourne.
- Smart locks Melbourne – Smart lock supplier and installer based in Melbourne.

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- Existing compatible lock replacement: **A$180–A$350**
- Installation requiring door modifications: **A$300–A$600+**
- If you're also buying the lock, the total usually ranges from **A$450–A$1,200+**, depending on the model and features. [www.newgenlocksmith.com.au](https://www.newgenlocksmith.com.au/services/smart-lock-installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you already have a smart lock, it's helpful to tell the installer:
- The **brand and model** (e.g. Yale, Aqara, Philips, Eufy, Lockwood).
- Whether your door is **timber, aluminium, or steel**.
- If it's a **house** or an **apartment** (fire-rated apartment doors may have additional requirements). [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/service?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you'd like, tell me:
- the **smart lock model** you have (or want to buy), and
- whether you're in **Newport VIC** or another Newport,

and I can advise on compatibility and give a more accurate installation estimate.
